title: Privacy: the erase tombstones chat history before the record write, so a refused erase has already erased the chat
evidence: Partial 2026-11-26 (root fix R3 PR 1 of 3, US-11 AC11, PR PRNUM): the read rule. ChatSession.open takes underErase, the record's erase identity, read at each use; under an erase the session neither lists, shows nor saves into a conversation last updated before erasedAt, its next write tombstones them, and its own replies are stamped no earlier than erasedAt (packages/health-core/src/chat-session.ts eraseCut, heldBefore, persist). The web passes the identity through widget-src/src/lib/chat-history-access.ts. Left: PR 2, the order of the erase steps on the web and in health-core (record-session-erase.ts, roadmap-data.ts deleteUserData), which lands only once phones carry the rule; PR 3, the iPhone engine passes the identity at its ChatSession.open call sites (ios/engine/app-doors.ts, cloud.ts) and moves its chat step (cloud.ts, erase.ts), with an engine release. Design: docs/drafts/s59a-chat-erase-order-design.md, option B. US-11 AC2, AC3, AC11
